description: This file defines an interface for a stateless worker grain in an Orleans project, specifying asynchronous methods for calling and retrieving call statistics.

classes.name: IStatelessWorkerGrain
classes.description: An interface representing a stateless worker grain with methods for long calls, retrieving call statistics, and dummy calls.

methods.name: GetCallStats
methods.description: Retrieves call statistics as a tuple containing a GUID, a string, and a list of timestamp pairs.
